[{"insert":"Back Squat Progression

The back squat finishes the cycle at fifteen reps per set, the highest reps of the block. High rep squats test your legs and your ability to keep pushing when tired. Brace hard at the top of every rep before you drop. The goal is the same depth and speed on rep fifteen as on rep one.
"}]
